subject: english
question:
**Fill in the blank with the most appropriate phrase:**

The board's decision to withdraw the bid came completely—————— for the stakeholders.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2 i.e. out of the blue**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The phrase **"out of the blue"** means something happening suddenly and unexpectedly, without any prior indication. (अचानक और अप्रत्याशित रूप से)
 
 
 
• **Example:** The announcement of her resignation came out of the blue for everyone in the office.
 
 
 
• In the given context, the board's decision to withdraw the bid was unexpected and surprised the stakeholders, making this phrase the most appropriate choice.
